headline: Centene (CNC) Stock Still Looks Like A Bargain As Its 150% Run Continues
summary: Centene stock has delivered a very strong 150.3% return over the past year, yet the latest valuation checks still point to the shares looking inexpensive relative to the fundamentals. Over the past 1 year, Centene is up 150.3%, which puts the recent pullback into context as a move within an already strong run.
